question.text: A trading member currently holds Rs. 25 lakhs BMC and now wishes to undertake algo trading. What is the additional BMC required to meet the source-supported tier?

answer.text: Rs. 50 lakhs (Rs. 25 lakhs for client trading upgrade + Rs. 25 lakhs for algo)

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook BMC tiers are: only proprietary, no algo — Rs. 10 lacs; only client, no algo — Rs. 15 lacs; proprietary plus client, no algo — Rs. 25 lacs; all brokers with algo — Rs. 50 lacs. To move from the Rs. 25 lakhs tier into the Rs. 50 lakhs "all brokers with algo" tier, the additional BMC required is Rs. 50 - Rs. 25 = Rs. 25 lakhs. The Trap: Rs. 50 lakhs is the total tier, not the incremental amount. Rs. 75 lakhs and Rs. 1 crore are not categories in the source table; they reflect a per-algo additive structure that the workbook does not support. Note: Source-backed to NISM-Series-IV workbook (Dec 2025), pages 289-290 (BMC table and eligibility context).
